mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = #{kind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId}

SELECT x.partner_id, COALESCE(c.code, s.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, x.balance, x.not_due, x.d30, x.d60, x.d90, x.over90 FROM ( SELECT b.partner_id, SUM(b.amount - COALESCE(st.settled, 0)) AS balance, SUM(CASE WHEN b.due_date >= #{asOf} THEN b.amount - COALESCE(st.settled, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS not_due, SUM(CASE WHEN b.due_date < #{asOf} AND b.due_date >= #{d30} THEN b.amount - COALESCE(st.settled, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS d30, SUM(CASE WHEN b.due_date < #{d30} AND b.due_date >= #{d60} THEN b.amount - COALESCE(st.settled, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS d60, SUM(CASE WHEN b.due_date < #{d60} AND b.due_date >= #{d90} THEN b.amount - COALESCE(st.settled, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS d90, SUM(CASE WHEN b.due_date < #{d90} THEN b.amount - COALESCE(st.settled, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS over90 FROM fin_bill b
LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.bill_id, SUM(si.amount) AS settled FROM fin_settlement_item si JOIN fin_settlement s ON s.id = si.settlement_id WHERE s.settle_date <= #{asOf} AND s.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY si.bill_id) st ON st.bill_id = b.id WHERE b.kind = #{kind} AND b.bill_date <= #{asOf} GROUP BY b.partner_id ) x LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON #{kind} = 'AR' AND c.id = x.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON #{kind} = 'AP' AND s.id = x.partner_id WHERE x.balance <> 0 ORDER BY x.balance DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_bill SET settled_fc = settled_fc + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", kind AS "kind", partner_id AS "partnerId", currency AS "currency", amount_fc - settled_fc AS "remainingFc", amount - settled_amount AS "remainingBase" FROM fin_bill WHERE currency <> 'CNY' AND amount_fc <> settled_fc AND bill_date <= #{asOf}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_bill SET bad_debt_amount = bad_debt_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE fin_bill SET invoiced_amount = invoiced_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ABS(invoiced_amount + #{amount}) <= ABS(amount) AND (invoiced_amount + #{amount}) * amount >= 0

UPDATE fin_bill SET status = CASE WHEN settled_amount + #{amount} = amount THEN 'SETTLED' WHEN settled_amount + #{amount} = 0 THEN 'UNSETTLED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, settled_amount = settled_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ((amount >= 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} >= 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} <= amount) OR (amount < 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} <= 0 AND settled_amount + #{amount} >= amount))
mapper.select: SELECT m.category AS "category", SUM(i.amount - i.tax_amount) AS "net", SUM(i.tax_amount) AS "tax" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.doc_id = #{tradeDocId} GROUP BY m.category
